text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days before the race, I decided to walk the Nakayama Racecourse track together with Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see... The start is here, that corner goes like this,
and then the straight is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey Trainer. Looking closely at it...
it's a real nice course. Just right for a stroll, too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The wind... feels real nice...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A relaxed expression. An unusual sense of composure for
Tamamo Cross, studying the course beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching that scene, a thought occurred to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The "White Lightning"—is right here!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the Senior champion who conquered both the
Takarazuka Kinen and the Tenno Sho (Autumn)
slowly makes her entrance!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama... This... intense spirit is...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So this is... the real Tama-chan...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooooh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a fierce energy that felt sharp enough to slice through the air.
Fierce enough to send a rumble through the entire venue...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Was Tamamo Cross... always this big?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No, nothing about her has changed from before.
Yet today... she looks like a giant...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, Creek, the day has finally come
to fulfill that promise we made.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You said it yourself at the end of summer, didn't ya?
"I wanna run together with all three of us."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... But...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tama-chan can't be doted on today.
In fact... it might be the other way around...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
This isn't the usual Tamamo Cross...
Tama... are you...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —This is the real me. Up until now, I just wasn't aggressive enough.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even a lightning bolt will just crash straight into the ground
if there aren't any clouds in the sky, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"But right now, even if I hone myself to an absolute razor edge,
I've got something that'll hold me together."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
My whole body is... tingling. Like it's about to
explode at any moment. With this body, this spirit—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri. I'll tear away from you.
I'm gonna leave you in the dust in a heartbeat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The celebrated Umamusume, Tamamo Cross. The perfected form of the White Lightning, unseen by anyone before, stood tall and dignified.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So this is Tama...
This is... Tamamo Cross...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
To be able to run with this Tamamo Cross, here today.
I... I...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy!!
Truly, deeply happy...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Let's win, I want to win!
Yes, I simply have to win—!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, yer something else. That's a "Monster" for ya.
That's the Oguri I recognized...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap faces that formidable presence head-on,
trembling with sheer excitement.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I'll show ya the lightning strike of a lifetime.
Today, in this grand finale Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I will become the wind—
and turn into light!!"
